command:
set -euo pipefail
R=/workspace/omega_runtime
OLD=$(readlink -f $R/current)
NEW=$R/releases/093e470c5c06e3568fda535f081be7f1dcd30035-sigma-cortex-retina-v1-reconcilerfix-001
CR=$R/carrier_repo
P=omega_deploy/093e470c5c06e3568fda535f081be7f1dcd30035-sigma-cortex-retina-v1/omega/receipt_reconciler.py
python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3, pathlib, json, sys
db=pathlib.Path('/workspace/omega_runtime/data/omega_unified.db')
con=sqlite3.connect(db)
try:
 r=con.execute("SELECT effect_id,organ_id,state FROM relay_ledger WHERE state='DISPATCHING' AND organ_id LIKE 'host:%'").fetchall()
finally: con.close()
print('ACTIVE_RELAY',json.dumps(r))
if r: sys.exit(31)
PY
rm -rf $NEW
cp -a $OLD $NEW
if git -C $CR cat-file -e omega-vps-deploy:$P 2>/dev/null; then REF=omega-vps-deploy; else REF=origin/omega-vps-deploy; fi
git -C $CR show $REF:$P > $NEW/omega/receipt_reconciler.py
PYTHONPATH=$NEW python3 -m py_compile $NEW/omega/receipt_reconciler.py $NEW/omega/spool_receipt_reconciler.py $NEW/omega/supervisor.py
OLDPID=$(python3 - <<'PY'
import json
print(json.load(open('/workspace/omega_runtime/state/SUPERVISOR_STATUS.json'))['pid'])
PY
)
kill -TERM $OLDPID
for i in $(seq 1 80); do
  if ! kill -0 $OLDPID 2>/dev/null; then break; fi
  ST=$(ps -o stat= -p $OLDPID 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' ' || true)
  case "$ST" in Z*|'') break;; esac
  sleep 0.25
done
if kill -0 $OLDPID 2>/dev/null; then ST=$(ps -o stat= -p $OLDPID 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' ' || true); case "$ST" in Z*) ;; *) echo OLD_SUPERVISOR_STILL_LIVE:$ST; exit 32;; esac; fi
ln -sfn $NEW $R/current.next
mv -Tf $R/current.next $R/current
nohup env PYTHONPATH=$NEW OMEGA_RUNTIME_ROOT=$R/state OMEGA_REPO_ROOT=$NEW OMEGA_UNIFIED_DB=$R/data/omega_unified.db python3 -m omega.supervisor --runtime-root $R/state --repo-root $NEW >> $R/state/logs/supervisor.log 2>&1 &
NEWPID=$!
OK=0
for i in $(seq 1 80); do
  sleep 0.25
  if python3 - <<PY
import json,pathlib,sys
p=pathlib.Path('$R/state/SUPERVISOR_STATUS.json')
try:d=json.loads(p.read_text())
except Exception:sys.exit(1)
ch=d.get('children',{})
sys.exit(0 if d.get('repo_root')=='$NEW' and ch.get('receipt_reconciler',{}).get('alive') is True and all(ch.get(x,{}).get('alive') is True for x in ['assembly','grid','relay','telemetry','master_bridge']) else 1)
PY
  then OK=1; break; fi
done
if [ $OK -ne 1 ]; then
  kill -TERM $NEWPID 2>/dev/null || true; sleep 2
  ln -sfn $OLD $R/current.next; mv -Tf $R/current.next $R/current
  nohup env PYTHONPATH=$OLD OMEGA_RUNTIME_ROOT=$R/state OMEGA_REPO_ROOT=$OLD OMEGA_UNIFIED_DB=$R/data/omega_unified.db python3 -m omega.supervisor --runtime-root $R/state --repo-root $OLD >> $R/state/logs/supervisor.log 2>&1 &
  echo ROLLBACK_START_FAILURE
  exit 33
fi
sleep 18
python3 - <<PY
import json,pathlib,sys,hashlib
r=pathlib.Path('$R'); d=json.loads((r/'state/SUPERVISOR_STATUS.json').read_text()); ch=d.get('children',{})
p=pathlib.Path('$NEW/omega/receipt_reconciler.py')
out={'result':'PASS' if d.get('repo_root')=='$NEW' and ch.get('receipt_reconciler',{}).get('alive') is True and ch.get('receipt_reconciler',{}).get('restart_count')==0 else 'FAIL','current':str((r/'current').resolve()),'supervisor_pid':d.get('pid'),'receipt_reconciler':ch.get('receipt_reconciler'),'file_sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'children_alive':{k:v.get('alive') for k,v in ch.items()}}
print(json.dumps(out,sort_keys=True))
if out['result']!='PASS': sys.exit(34)
PY
